item.title: San Diego Police warn about 'bank jugging' criminals during Lunar New Year
item.description: Police are warning that criminals may take advantage of the increase in cash transactions tied to the Lunar New Year holiday, and are urging residents to remain vigilant when withdrawing money.

item.title: Two men stabbed during suspected gang-related altercation in Escondido
item.description: ESCONDIDO, Calif. (FOX 5/KUSI) -- The Escondido Police Department confirmed two men suffered stab wounds in Escondido on Saturday evening during an altercation. According to EPD, the incident occurred around 7 p.m. near West Valley Parkway, with one man reportedly suffering two stab wounds, while the other man received one. item.title: Tyler Reddick wins Daytona 500 after team's car displayed at SDSU
item.description: Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 on Sunday, securing a major victory for 23XI Racing, after the team's SDSU-branded car was displayed during NASCAR Night at the San Diego State men's basketball game.

item.title: Heavy rain and snow to hit San Diego County this week
item.description: A strong Pacific storm system is bringing heavy rain, strong winds, high surf and snow to San Diego County, with temperatures dropping to below average and flooding expected.

item.title: Family hosts memorial horse event to honor Amber Dubois
item.description: The Amber Dubois Memorial Show is a two-day horse riding competition open to riders of all ages, held in honor of 14-year-old Amber Dubois who was abducted and killed in 2009.

item.title: Authorities investigate fatal three-vehicle crash in East County
item.description: A fatal three-vehicle crash in La Presa Friday night left one person dead and sent others to the hospital, and the California Highway Patrol is investigating the incident.

item.title: Police investigate fatal hit-and-run crash near Poway
item.description: A deadly hit-and-run crash occurred near Poway on Saturday night, resulting in one fatality and one major injury. One driver allegedly fled the scene.

item.title: Armed robbery reported in Spring Valley, suspect at large
item.description: The San Diego Sheriff's Office is responding to reports of an armed robbery in Spring Valley, with a perimeter set up around the area but no suspect in custody as of 10:30 p.m.

item.title: Candlelight vigil held for Poway hit-and-run victim
item.description: A candlelight vigil was held for the victim of a fatal hit-and-run crash that happened near Poway on Saturday night.
